*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Twenty-seven people are killed and at least 106 others are injured when rockets are fired at a market in [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twenty-two people are killed and seven injured after a road accident near [[Francistown]], [[Botswana]]. [https://english.news.cn/africa/20230602/b2f2c8f6e6464d6daf189d2e2679ad7e/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Three people in [[Lakhsh District]], eastern [[Tajikistan]] are killed by a [[landslide]]. [https://www.rferl.org/amp/tajikistan-mudslide-children-killed/32439112.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2018–2023 Haitian crisis]]
**At least 160 suspected gang members were killed in [[Haiti]] between April 24 and May 24 by armed citizens after an increase in violence across the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/1/haiti-vigilante-push-symptomatic-of-states-failures-advocates (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Bill Cosby sexual assault cases]]
**A new lawsuit is filed against American actor [[Bill Cosby]] by ''[[Playboy]]'' model [[Victoria Valentino]], accusing him of drugging and raping her in 1969. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna87298 (NBC News)]
*Nine people are killed during protests in [[Dakar]] and [[Ziguinchor]], [[Senegal]], between the [[Law enforcement in Senegal|police]] and supporters of convicted opposition leader [[Ousmane Sonko]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230601-senegal-opposition-figure-ousmane-sonko-sentenced-to-two-years-for-corrupting-youth (France 24)]
*Four people are injured by a knife attack at a school in [[Eskilstuna]], [[Södermanland]], [[Sweden]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/several-people-injured-knife-attack-swedish-school-tv4-2023-06-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Authorities find 45 bags containing human remains in [[Jalisco]], [[Mexico]], after seven people were reported missing in the state last week. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/45-bags-human-remains-mexico-guadalajara/ (CBS News)]
*A [[Judiciary of Switzerland|Swiss appeals court]] finds former [[Liberia]]n [[United Liberation Movement of Liberia for Democracy|rebel]] commander [[Alieu Kosiah]] guilty of [[crimes against humanity]] committed during the [[First Liberian Civil War]], [[sentence (law)|sentencing]] him to 20 years in prison at [[first instance]]. [https://www.sinardaily.my/article/197500/world/europe/swiss-court-upholds-ex-liberian-warlords-20-year-sentence (''Sinar Daily'')]
*[[President of El Salvador|Salvadoran President]] [[Nayib Bukele]] announces that the [[government of El Salvador|government]] will construct a prison to hold [[white-collar crime|white-collar criminals]]. He also announces that the country's security forces had raided the properties of former president [[Alfredo Cristiani]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-president-pledges-white-collar-prison-war-corruption-2023-06-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Salvadoran general election]]
**Nayib Bukele officially proposes two bills to the [[Legislative Assembly of El Salvador|Legislative Assembly]] to reduce the number of [[Municipalities of El Salvador|municipalities]] from 262 to 44 and the number of seats in the Legislative Assembly from 84 to 60. [https://www.laprensagrafica.com/elsalvador/EN-VIVO-Presdiente-Nayib-Bukele-da-discurso-por-cuatro-anos-de-Gobierno-20230601-0066.html (''La Prensa Gráfica'')]
*[[Capital punishment in Zimbabwe]]
**The [[parliament of Zimbabwe]] votes in favour of a new clause of the penal code which will introduce the [[Capital punishment|death penalty]] for "unpatriotic acts" such as supporting sanctions on the country or supporting calls to overthrow the government. [https://africafeeds.com/2023/06/01/zimbabwes-new-bill-that-imposes-death-penalty-for-unpatriotic-acts/ (''Africa Feeds'')]
*[[Wedding of Hussein, Crown Prince of Jordan, and Rajwa Al Saif]]
**[[Crown Prince of Jordan]] [[Hussein, Crown Prince of Jordan|Hussein bin Abdullah]] marries [[Saudis|Saudi]] architect and distant relative of the [[House of Saud|Saud family]] [[Princess Rajwa Al Hussein|Rajwa Al Saif]] in the [[Jordan]]ian capital of [[Amman]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/06/01/middleeast/jordan-saudi-royal-wedding-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2023 United States debt-ceiling crisis]]
**The [[United States Senate]] passes the [[Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023]], sending the measure to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] to sign in order to avoid a [[United States debt ceiling|debt ceiling]] default. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/debt-ceiling-bill-passes-senate/ (CBS News)]
